main_text.l: MVnus Christi sacerdotale non leuiter impetunt quotidiana sacrificij Missalis oblatio, & numerus mediatorum : Quod ad primum : Esse quidem in sacrâ hâc cœnâ(quo sensu Patres olim locuti sunt) sacrificium, nemo nostrum est, qui vnquam dubitârit ; illud nempe siue λατρευτικον (vt Bellarminus non malè distinguit) siue ευχαεισικον. Est hîc (vt Chrysostomus) ἀνάμνησις τῆς θυσίας, id est (interprete Augustino) memoria dominicæ passionis,

marginalia.note: Vid. Valent. Vanni.de Miss. Cit. ab Luc. Osiandr. Confut. Thef. Cofteri.

page.notes: Greek words in the text are printed as λατρευτικον, εὐχαριστικον and ἀνάμνησις τῆς θυσίας; the printed εὐχαεισικον is rendered as printed. The faint text at the top and the "Sect." at the foot are show-through and were left out. The bottom "in" is a catchword.
